openings.claim: Envelope pattern/quantity marks and insertion ticks may reduce memory errors and assignment exchanges; ticks depend on accurate picked counts and faithful marking.
openings.discriminator: Compare cues against local staging with matched mixtures; record whether shortages originate in picking or filling. Correct ticks with incomplete contents challenge reliability; accurate picking followed by filling omissions weakens the upstream concern.
openings.probe: Proposed 18-minute comparison: three matched four-kit batches, shared trays, marked shared-tray envelopes, and loose staging. Include preparation/audit; observe picked counts, ticks and contents for the four marked kits. Tally crossings and time; stop on table overflow.
openings.uncertainty: Mark legibility, observation effects and cap feasibility unknown; rare sample consultation does not locate omissions. Local-staging superiority would challenge quantity-memory dominance.

openings.claim: Separate lanes with limited pattern-specific local batches, exterior identities and preclosure checks may reduce interference; replenishment and opened packets may erase the small-batch benefit.
openings.discriminator: Fewer crossings without improved omissions/time defeats the causal benefit. Matching mixtures addresses easier-pattern confounding; full-run performance tests replenishment feasibility.
openings.probe: First twelve required kits: comparable six-kit shared/local batches, balanced volunteers where feasible. Verify lane footprint; record occupied space, packet opening, staging, replenishment, filling, checking and pre-correction omissions. Retain corrected kits; stop if completion is threatened.
openings.uncertainty: Mixture comparability, footprint and replenishment overhead unknown; O4 cannot establish scale. Existing stock does not establish staged capacity.

lineage.reason: Cues, assignment and staging rival retained.

decision: Probe before adoption. Preserve exact pattern quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, 180-by-75-centimetre table, existing envelopes/supplies and no equipment/purchases. All preparation, replenishment, assembly and checking share 90 minutes. Require 60 complete assigned kits before workshop and at most one distribution correction. Synthetic stipulations establish no tested benefit or full-run success.
